//: Channel knowledge: what a channel's own team knows about writing for it. One set per channel per workspace (content-workspace.js saveChannelKnowledge), edited in Studio › My channel (channel owners, their own channel) or Studio › Channels (admins and editors, any channel). It goes into that channel's asset prompts after the workspace's brand knowledge, on every AI route (content-studio.js buildContentPlan).

fields.label: Who this channel speaks to
fields.placeholder: The readers or followers this channel reaches, what they already know and what they come for.

fields.label: Voice and tone
fields.placeholder: How this channel sounds, in a few words or examples. For example: friendly, plain, one idea per post.

fields.label: Format rules
fields.placeholder: Length, structure, headings, hashtags, emoji, links and calls to action this channel uses.

fields.label: Always do
fields.placeholder: What every piece for this channel should do.

fields.label: Never do
fields.placeholder: Words, claims or styles this channel avoids.

fields.label: Examples that worked
fields.placeholder: Paste a few posts or intros that did well, so the AI can follow their shape.

fields.label: Reference links
fields.placeholder: Style guides, past pieces or pages the team uses, one per line.
